pngtuberRemix.connected.description: Runs when Cuebot connects to PNGTuber Remix.

variables.pngtuberRemix.host: The computer PNGTuber Remix runs on

pngtuberRemix.disconnected.description: Runs when the connection to PNGTuber Remix drops, for example because you closed it or pressed Stop in its WebSocket tab.

variables.pngtuberRemix.host: The computer PNGTuber Remix runs on

pngtuberRemix.setState.description: Switches your PNGTuber Remix avatar to another state, like pressing one of its state buttons (for example Idle, Smug or Angry).

fields.state: The state's name, or its number: 1 is the first state button, 2 the second and so on.

variables.pngtuberRemix.state: The name of the state now showing

pngtuberRemix.getState.description: Finds out which avatar state is showing right now, so later steps can use it.

variables.pngtuberRemix.state: The name of the state showing
variables.pngtuberRemix.states: All the state names, separated by commas

pngtuberRemix.setVisibility.description: Shows or hides one sprite of your avatar, like a hat or glasses. Pick Group to also show or hide everything attached to it.

fields.sprite: The sprite's name as in PNGTuber Remix's Sprites list (or its sprite ID).
fields.what: Just this sprite, or this sprite and everything attached to it.
fields.state: Visible, Hidden, or Toggle (the opposite of now).

variables.pngtuberRemix.visible: True when it is now visible, false when hidden

pngtuberRemix.shake.description: Shakes a sprite for a moment, for example your whole avatar when someone raids.

fields.sprite: The sprite's name (pick the top sprite to shake the whole avatar).
fields.strength: How far it shakes, in pixels. Empty means 10.
fields.seconds: How long it shakes. Empty means 1 second.

pngtuberRemix.bounce.description: Makes a sprite jump up once, like a little hop of joy.

fields.height: How high it jumps, in pixels. Empty means 20.
fields.seconds: How long the jump takes. Empty means half a second.

pngtuberRemix.move.description: Moves a sprite somewhere, makes it bigger or smaller, or tilts it, smoothly. It can go back by itself afterwards.

fields.x: Where to move it, left (smaller) or right (bigger), in pixels. Leave X and Y empty to not move it.
fields.y: Where to move it, up (smaller) or down (bigger), in pixels.
fields.scale: 1 is normal size, 2 is twice as big, 0.5 half. Empty means keep the size.
fields.rotation: How many degrees to tilt it, for example 15. Empty means no tilt.
fields.seconds: How long the change takes. Empty means 1 second.
fields.returnAfter: Seconds before it goes back to how it was. Empty means it stays.

pngtuberRemix.throw.description: Throws things at your avatar, using the images you added as throwables in PNGTuber Remix. Great for bits or channel points.

fields.item: The name of one throwable image. Leave empty for random ones.
fields.amount: How many to throw. It can use %arguments%, for example a number of bits.

pngtuberRemix.pauseThrowing.description: Pauses or resumes throwing, for example while you are on a break.

fields.state: Paused, Running, or Toggle (the opposite of now).

variables.pngtuberRemix.throwingPaused: True when throwing is now paused

pngtuberRemix.loadModel.description: Opens another saved PNGTuber Remix model, for example a different outfit for a special stream.

fields.path: The full path of the .pngRemix file, for example C:/Models/Party.pngRemix.
